description: This file defines a Python module for parsing and handling test configuration YAML files within the Twister testing framework. It includes functions and a class for extracting fields, type casting, and retrieving scenario data with validation.

classes.name: TwisterConfigParser
classes.description: A class to read, validate, and process test scenario YAML files with semantic checking.

methods.name: extract_fields_from_arg_list
methods.description: Extracts specified fields from a list of 'FIELD=VALUE' arguments, returning the extracted fields and remaining arguments.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and verifies the YAML configuration file, populating scenarios and common data.

methods.name: _cast_value
methods.description: Converts a value to a specified type, handling strings, lists, sets, floats, ints, and booleans with deprecation warnings for space-separated lists.

methods.name: get_scenario
methods.description: Retrieves a scenario's configuration as a dictionary, applying defaults, type casting, and validation, with support for extracting specific argument fields.
